key_impacts: Government imposed a Movement Control Order (MCO) in multiple phases from 18 March to 12 May 2020.
The 2020 Asia Pacific Science and Technology Conference on DRR (scheduled 16–17 March in Malaysia) was cancelled due to COVID-19.
Many other large SEADPRI-UKM events in 2020 were cancelled.
SEADPRI-UKM staff shifted to working from home and conducted meetings and teaching online.
missing_information: Case and fatality numbers in Malaysia are not provided.
Specific localities within Malaysia most affected are not identified.
Impacts beyond May 2020 are not detailed in this source.
